text: …せや　ここで　あったのも　なんかの　ごえんや！

structure.jp: ここで　あったのも
なんかの　ごえんや！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, and も adds 'too'. ここで　あったのも = 'the fact that we met here, too'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the Kansai-dialect way of saying だ, 'it is'. せや at the start is the same thing, Kansai for そうだ. ごえんや = 'it's fate'.
